## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be referenced through `settings/vendor_sbx.toml` rather than an environment variable.  
Run `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` in between other work; execute its steps in order, one at a time.  
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.  
Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.  
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination is superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Acme: `org_acme_industries`, `REQ-2025-01842`, `enterprise-annual`, `USD`, migration `0042`, setup fee `2500.00`.  
Staging DB: `db-stg-2.internal`; `db-stg-1.internal` is superseded.  
CSV export now explicitly uses UTF-8.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying all HTTP errors: 4xx must fail immediately; retry only transport errors and retryable server responses.  
Increasing SQLAlchemy pool size to 50: caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.

## Plan and progress
Onboarding steps 1–3 done; step 3 exited 0. Step 4 status unknown because its command was not provided.  
Invoice annotations: baseline passed (`12 passed`); `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict` imported, `LineItem` and `build_invoice_lines` annotated; compileall succeeded.  
Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`
